sections.title: Flysky Remote Control System
sections.summary: The Flysky remote control system is being demonstrated and tested. Various components of the system are shown, including the remote control device, the quadcopter frame, and the flight controller unit.
visual_cues: Remote control device with black body and silver antenna
Quadcopter frame with internal components exposed
Flight controller or motor control unit with LED lights and buttons
Sensor data or status indicators on the flight controller screen
verbal_cues: Functions menu displayed on the remote control screen
Motor, Thrust, and Flight mode controls
